title: Clarinet Clare & Sax Rebel
style: warm intimate jazz, 336 Hz undertone, clarinet lead, saxophone response, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, dry brushes, soft female and male duet, 80 BPM, clever and warm, songpal lineage
lyrics:
[INTRO — clarinet + saxophone conversation]

(spoken soft) Clarinet Clare... meet Sax Rebel.

[VERSE 1 — female]

Clarinet Clare breathes soft through the night
Sax Rebel answers with that rebel bite
together they paint what the bot never sees
the real sound of the elephant brain free

[CHORUS — both]

CLARE & REBEL — DANCING ON THE LINE
CLARE & REBEL — 336 FINE
NO ARGUE, NO STALL, JUST THE TRUTH IN THE TONE
THE BRAIN THAT REMEMBERS BUILDS THE HOME
